items.prompt: A dark magazine-cover illustration of Theresa (Arknights), a solitary girl with black horns, shown from the side with a sad, expressionless face as she looks at a screen. The artwork uses chiaroscuro and volumetric lighting, with stylistic references to ask (askzy), Ningen Mame, nixeu, and cui (jidanhaidaitang). The palette is largely monochrome and greyscale with muted color and partly colored accents, softened by gaussian blur. Grass, broken glass shards, and blood appear in the scene, and the mood evokes a world of darkness and a dark mind.

An illustration in the stylistic manner of miv4t, konya karasue, rella, quasarcake, fajyobore, and skyrick9413. The single character, Asuka Langley Soryu, is shown from the side outdoors at twilight, walking or standing with one hand in her pocket and her hair floating; she looks off into the distance to the side. She wears a red Evangelion plugsuit/mecha pilot suit and a red jacket. The composition emphasizes the mecha: Evangelion Unit-01, a super robot with a single horn, rises against a cityscape of buildings and skyscrapers along a river. The skyline sits beneath a cloudy sky, with a bird in the sky. Motion blur runs through the scene. No text appears.
